children.name: Mayaca baumii Gürke
children.description: The native range of this species is Congo, S. DR Congo to Angola. It is a hydrosubshrub and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Mayaca fluviatilis Aubl.
children.description: Mayaca fluviatilis, also known as bog moss, is a perennial herbaceous submerged plant in the monogeneric family Mayacaceae.

children.name: Mayaca kunthii Seub.
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Venezuela to Uruguay. It is a hydrosubshrub and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Mayaca longipes Mart. ex Seub.
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Trop. America. It is a hydrosubshrub and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Mayaca sellowiana Kunth
children.description: The native range of this species is Costa Rica to S. Trop. America. It is a hydrosubshrub and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.
